summary.suggested: The St. Louis Globe-Democrat reported that Tom Allen was leaving St. Louis on a sparring tour of Louisville, Cincinnati, Columbus, Cleveland, Pittsburg and Buffalo, with Young Donnelly as his partner.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Wednesday Morning, December 1, 1875

facts.fact: Allen left St. Louis on a sparring exhibition tour of Louisville, Cincinnati, Columbus, Cleveland, Pittsburg, Buffalo and other cities, accompanied by Young Donnelly as his sparring partner
